The 2009 German Grand Prix, held at the Nürburgring on 12 July 2009 (round 9), was won by Mark Webber of Red Bull. He started from pole position, with teammate Sebastian Vettel second and Felipe Massa of Ferrari third.

ANSWER: Mark Webber
